name: Finding Validation
description: Reproduce or disprove security candidates and issue a conservative reportability verdict.
author: Dyadic
abilities: Builds a fact-by-fact exploitation decision matrix
Uses safe proofs and explicit negative controls
Separates reportability, confidence, severity, and scope
permissions: Read-only validation unless an isolated or live test is specifically authorized
Does not submit, patch, or externally track findings

changes.notes: Adopt owner-authored security workflow with self-contained references and explicit runtime discovery.
